🏥 The NHS figure ministers won't shout about.

Cases waiting MORE THAN A YEAR for treatment rose by over 11,000 between March and June, from 94,404 to 105,711, according to the Royal College of Surgeons. Up in every region of England.

The waiting list is stuck at 7.3 million. Only 65.8% seen within 18 weeks against a 92% target.

Behind every number is someone in pain, waiting. 💙
